sections.title: Performance Analysis: Crucible_Tools (RuFlo V3)
sections.content:
This is a Node.js agent orchestration framework — no React components or SQL ORM. The five categories below are mapped to what actually exists.

---

sections.title: 1. N+1 Write Patterns
2. Redundant Trigram Recomputation
3. Caching Opportunities
4. Memory Leak Risks
5. Redundant Computations
sections.content:
**`.claude/helpers/metrics-db.mjs:306-309` — three file reads for CVE checks**

`checkSecurityFile()` reads and splits a file each call. All three are called back-to-back:

```js
const cve1Fixed = checkSecurityFile('input-validator.ts');
const cve2Fixed = checkSecurityFile('path-validator.ts');
const cve3Fixed = checkSecurityFile('safe-executor.ts');
```

These files don't change during a single `syncMetrics()` run. Already minimal cost, but the pattern is the same file path read three times if any file is referenced by multiple CVEs. No change needed unless this becomes a hot path.

**`.claude/helpers/intelligence.cjs:462-483` — `init()` rebuilds rankedEntries on every `init()` call outside the 60s cache window**

The 60-second freshness window (`age < 60000`) is good. Consider extending it to 5 minutes for non-interactive contexts (background workers), since the graph is only as stale as the memory store, which changes rarely:

```js
const GRAPH_TTL = process.env.CLAUDE_FLOW_GRAPH_TTL
  ? parseInt(process.env.CLAUDE_FLOW_GRAPH_TTL)
  : 300000;  // 5 min default, overridable
if (age < GRAPH_TTL) { return { ... 'Graph cache hit' }; }
```

---

sections.title: Summary Table
sections.content:
| Finding | File | Line | Impact |
|---|---|---|---|
| N+1 db.run in module loop | `metrics-db.mjs` | 268 | N write transactions → 1 |
| N+1 CVE updates | `metrics-db.mjs` | 324-326 | Minor, cosmetic |
| Trigrams recomputed per-query | `intelligence.cjs` | 521 | CPU on every hook fire |
| Full JSON file read per `memory` op | `memory.cjs` | 13 | Disk I/O on every hook |
| Double directory traversal | `metrics-db.mjs` | 261, 285 | Redundant fs walk |
| Unbounded JSONL append | `context-persistence-hook.mjs` | append path | Disk leak over time |
| HNSWIndex stale layer references | `learning-service.mjs` | ~232 | Memory growth with churn |
| 60s graph TTL too short | `intelligence.cjs` | 415 | Unnecessary rebuilds |

The highest-leverage fixes are (1) the `memory.cjs` read cache — it fires on every hook — and (2) precomputing trigrams in `rankedEntries` to avoid per-query recomputation in `getContext()`.
